subject.title: fix(plugins): bound marketplace manifest file reads

question: Should marketplace manifest loading intentionally become 16 MiB capped and regular-file-only once diagnostics and real behavior proof are fixed?
rationale: This hardening closes a real unbounded-read path, but it also changes the upgrade contract for existing large or symlinked marketplace manifests, which is a maintainer compatibility choice.

options.title: Land strict manifest reads after repair
options.body: Accept the 16 MiB cap and regular-file-only requirement after the PR preserves accurate errors and adds real CLI proof.

options.title: Preserve more compatibility
options.body: Require a narrower implementation that caps byte reads but keeps any existing symlink or non-regular handling that maintainers consider supported.

options.title: Defer the hardening
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers are not ready to choose a manifest size limit or regular-file-only contract for marketplace manifests.

recommendation.title: Land strict manifest reads after repair
recommendation.body: Accept the 16 MiB cap and regular-file-only requirement after the PR preserves accurate errors and adds real CLI proof.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc introduced the marketplace loader and is the clearest routing owner for marketplace compatibility decisions.
